description: Get Auditor-General of South Africa (AGSA) audit outcomes for municipalities. Opinion codes: clean=Clean Audit, unqualified_emphasis_of_matter=Unqualified with Emphasis of Matter, qualified=Qualified Opinion, adverse=Adverse Opinion, disclaimer=Disclaimer of Opinion. Returns year, opinion label, and PDF report URL. Filter by demarcation code and/or year. Data covers 2010-2024 for all 257 municipalities. Useful for transparency reporting, credit risk assessment, and governance analysis. No auth required. Source: SA National Treasury MFMA data portal.

demarcation_code.description: Municipality demarcation code to filter (e.g. CPT=Cape Town, JHB=Johannesburg, ETH=eThekwini/Durban, TSH=Tshwane, EKU=Ekurhuleni). Omit to retrieve opinions across all municipalities.

limit.description: Maximum number of audit opinion records to return (1-100, default 20).

year.description: Financial year-end filter (e.g. 2022 = financial year ended June 2022). Range: 2010-2024.

name: samuni.finance.audit_opinions

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: SA Municipal — Audit Opinions
